text.tspan: Palette entries used by the design
idx name R G B used for
4 Yellow FF D7 00 COL_YELLOW (cursor, sun HUD,
10 White FF FF FF HUD digits
12 Orange FF A5 00 COL_ORANGE (selector box 1 fill)
13 Sky Blue 87 CE EB bg_grid outside-grid fill
COL_TRANSPARENT = 8'hFF (sentinel, NOT a real palette entry)
Index 0xFF is reserved by entity_drawer as the
for pixels that should not be drawn, and the
stage-2 mux skips that layer. The palette entry
at 0xFF falls through to the default arm of the
case, so it reads as black — but the drawer
never lets that value reach this module.
forces VGA_R/G/B to 0 regardless of palette
only visible during the active scan.
